# 🔒 安全政策 / Security Policy

## 中文

Anything-AI 是一个开放的知识索引项目，本身不处理敏感数据。但如果你发现以下安全问题，请**不要公开提 Issue**，而是通过私密渠道报告：

- 网站（GitHub Pages）存在可被利用的漏洞
- 自动化脚本存在安全隐患
- 仓库配置（如密钥泄露）问题

**报告方式**：发送邮件至 `2235998553@qq.com`，或直接在 GitHub 上私密联系维护者 [@konglong87](https://github.com/konglong87)。

我们会在收到报告后尽快响应并修复。

---

## English

Anything-AI is an open knowledge index and does not process sensitive data. However, if you find a security issue, **please do not open a public issue**. Report it privately instead:

- Exploitable vulnerabilities on the site (GitHub Pages)
- Security flaws in the automation scripts
- Repository configuration issues (e.g. leaked secrets)

**How to report**: Email `2235998553@qq.com`, or privately contact the maintainer [@konglong87](https://github.com/konglong87) on GitHub.

We will respond and fix issues as quickly as possible.
